messages.author: a4333a23db63e704
messages.subject: remove duplicated legends
parts:
Hi, 

i have microbiota data and have imported into R as a phyloseq.

When i plot the data as attached i have duplicated legends "Rank5" and "Family". The code i use are as below.

p = plot_bar(ent10, "Rank2", fill = "Rank5", facet_grid = ~SampleType) 

p + geom_bar(aes(color=Rank5, fill=Rank5), stat="identity", position="stack") +
  xlab("Phylum") +
  labs(fill = "Family")

Does anyone know how to remove the duplicated legends?

Thanks.

Regards,
Goh.

messages.author: 5eea1e9bb9aab8cb
messages.subject: Re: remove duplicated legends
parts: I think it's picking legend from 'p' barplot as well. To remove the legend from GGplot : use this - theme(legend.position = "none")

messages.subject: Re: remove duplicated legends
parts:
Goh,

You might try a minimally reproducible example (https://stackoverflow.com/a/5963610/393354). If creating one doesn't solve the problem, at least the rest of us will have working code to test and provide feedback on.

Absent a working example, I'd suggest trying to name both labels the same in labs()—ggplot2 usually plots series with the same name and levels on a single legend, though I haven't encountered this particular use-case before.

Good luck,

Tom
